plan.summary: Plan for package E-company-1 (Sprint 1, P0). The problem: after a client accepts, the winning firm's slot stays OFFER_SENT, and withdrawals only check the slot status. So the winner can still withdraw with any reason, including an auto-approved CLIENT_UNRESPONSIVE_48H, get a full refund and leave the client stuck. The winner can also still mark the job delivered after withdrawing. The fix has 4 parts: (1) refuse every withdrawal path (request(), handleAdminReview(), adminReview approve) with 409 CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE when the request is in REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES or the slot has an ACCEPTED quote. This is checked early outside the transaction for fast failure, and again atomically under the existing FOR UPDATE by adding relation filters to the closeSlot updateMany. (2) markDelivered is refused unless the winner slot is still OFFER_SENT (early check plus a check in the transaction under a new request FOR UPDATE). (3) Only OWNER/MANAGER may withdraw or mark delivered; the claimer or assignee may withdraw only within the 30-minute grace (403 FORBIDDEN otherwise). (4) The frontend hides the withdraw form for accepted quotes and settled requests, and for staff without permission, and hides 'Marchează ca livrată' for non-managers and non-deliverable states. The page gets two additive fields on ClaimQuoteContextDto: requestStatus and claimedAt. No migration, no new error codes. Local DB check: 0 already-exploited winner slots. The demo request 7575c23e (IN_EXECUTION, winner A Mobila Premium, slot 66779b59) is the live target for verification.
modules: frontend: marketplace firma work sheet (claim page + ClaimLifecyclePanel)
tables: claim_slots (read + conditional updateMany now also filtered on request status and no ACCEPTED quote)
claim_withdrawals (no new rows on refused paths)
quotes (read: ACCEPTED quote per slot)
requests (read status; new SELECT ... FOR UPDATE in markDelivered)
company_credit_wallets / credit_transactions (no new movements; refused paths must not refund/consume)
company_members (role comes from companyContext; no new query)
assumptions: docs/03 §4.15 and docs/07 (D5, Î18, D-L0-5) cover withdrawals only while the claim is in play. No rule or decision allows withdrawing after acceptance, so blocking it matches the docs and reopens no decision.

A winner's slot stays OFFER_SENT until completeDelivered moves it to COMPLETED. acceptQuote closes only the losers. This does not change: the fix blocks withdrawal, it does not change the winner slot's status.
REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES (ACCEPTED, IN_EXECUTION, DELIVERED_BY_COMPANY, COMPLETED, DISPUTED) is the right 'accepted or later' set. It is already used by the SLA/assign processors.

Prisma updateMany accepts relation filters (request: {...}, quotes: { none: {...} }) in ClaimSlotWhereInput. The condition is evaluated atomically in the same statement, under the request FOR UPDATE that every withdrawal path already takes.
Role comes from ctx.memberRole set by CompanyApprovedGuard, so no extra DB query. The grace window is measured from claim_slots.created_at (same as handleVoluntary, Î18, wall-clock).

Local DB check on 2026-09-29: 0 slots with an ACCEPTED quote in a status other than OFFER_SENT/COMPLETED, so no data repair is needed locally. Production should run the same read-only query before deploy.
Demo accounts share the password Cozydemo2026 (local only). managed.a@demo.ro is EMPLOYEE_MANAGED and mgr.a@demo.ro is MANAGER in A Mobila Premium; owner.b@demo.ro owns B DesignWood.
Frontend messages ro.json/en.json are currently LF (checked with `file`); keep the existing formatting and indentation.

decisions.question: Who may withdraw a claim and who may mark delivery? docs/03 §4.7 only says EMPLOYEE_MANAGED cannot claim; nothing covers withdraw or deliver.
decisions.chosen_default: Follows the approved package steps. Withdraw: OWNER/MANAGER at any time, subject to state checks. Any other member only if they are the slot's claimedByUserId or assignedToUserId AND inside the 30-minute grace from claim_slots.created_at (any reason); otherwise 403 FORBIDDEN. Mark delivered: OWNER/MANAGER only; everyone else gets 403 FORBIDDEN. Uses the existing FORBIDDEN code, as claims.service assign() does.
decisions.why_safe: Least-privilege and reversible (a one-line role list change). It matches existing gates: assign is OWNER/MANAGER, claim is forbidden to EMPLOYEE_MANAGED, and CompanyManagerGuard protects money routes. It changes no prices, points or refund policy.

decisions.question: PO confirmation needed: should EMPLOYEE_TRUSTED members (or the assigned person) also be allowed to (a) mark delivery and (b) withdraw after the 30-minute grace? The current default is no for both.
decisions.chosen_default: No for both (owner/manager only). The UI shows a short 'only owner or manager' note instead of the form.
decisions.why_safe: The most restrictive option. Widening it later is a single role list change with no data impact.

decisions.question: Does a winning firm get any exit after the client accepts, such as withdrawing with refund, or with consume and penalty?
decisions.chosen_default: No self-service exit: every withdrawal reason returns 409 CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE once the quote is ACCEPTED or the request is settled. Admins handle exceptional cases by hand until the dedicated post-acceptance cancellation flow (separate ACCEPTED dead-end package) exists.
decisions.why_safe: docs/03 §4.15 and docs/07 D5/Î18/D-L0-5 define no post-acceptance withdrawal. Blocking invents no refund or penalty rule and keeps the invariant 'each RESERVE ends in exactly one refund or consume' (the winner consumes at COMPLETED).

decisions.question: What happens to a PENDING_ADMIN_REVIEW withdrawal whose slot then wins the acceptance?
decisions.chosen_default: Admin approve returns 409 CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE (no refund). Admin reject still works, so the queue can be cleared. The admin page now shows the mapped error message.
decisions.why_safe: Reject moves no money. Approve would refund a winner, which is the exploit itself.

decisions.question: Do legacy slots already exploited (winner WITHDRAWN with an ACCEPTED quote) need a data fix?
decisions.chosen_default: No migration. The local DB has 0 such rows. The brief includes a read-only SQL check to run on prod before deploy. markDelivered now refuses these slots with 409 DELIVERY_NOT_ALLOWED, and admins handle any hits manually.
decisions.why_safe: Read-only check; no rows are rewritten automatically.

PACKAGE E-company-1 - "Stop firms from quitting after the client says yes" (Sprint 1, P0). Findings WF1-2 (P0) + WF1-10 (P2). Read first: Codex "50 Impact/IMPACT accept si claim.md", "IMPACT credite.md", "10 Module BE/BE claims.md", "BE fulfillment.md", "40 Concepte/CONCEPT autorizare.md"; .claude/skills/nestjs-module/SKILL.md and ui-component/SKILL.md. No schema change, no migration, no new ERROR_CODES (reuse CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE, FORBIDDEN, DELIVERY_NOT_ALLOWED). SAFETY: Do NOT call POST /claims/66779b59-.../withdraw or POST /company/requests/7575c23e-.../deliver against the running backend until step 2 and step 4 are saved and `nest --watch` has recompiled. Before the fix, these calls really run the exploit (a refund) or change the demo data. === STEP 1 - failing tests first (apps/backend/src/modules/claims/withdrawals.service.spec.ts) === - Update the `slot()` factory. Add `claimedByUserId: 'u1', assignedToUserId: null, quotes: []` and change `request` to `{ lastEditAt: null, status: 'CLAIMED_PARTIAL', title: 'T' }`. The existing ctx is OWNER, so the existing tests stay green. - The tx mock `claimSlot.findUnique` must also return `request: { status: 'CLAIMED_PARTIAL' }, quotes: []`. The simplest way is the same slot object; it already does that. - New describe 'E-company-1 - castigatorul nu mai poate retrage dupa accept': a) it.each over all 6 WITHDRAWAL_REASON_TYPES (CUSTOM with customReason 'x'): slot({ status: 'OFFER_SENT', quotes: [{ id: 'q1' }], request: { lastEditAt: new Date(), status: 'ACCEPTED', title: 'T' } }), ctx OWNER. Expect rejects `{ status: 409, response: { code: 'CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE' } }`. Also expect credits.refund, credits.consume, penalties.applyPenalty, tx.claimSlot.updateMany and claimWithdrawal.create NOT called. b) it.each(['IN_EXECUTION','DELIVERED_BY_COMPANY','COMPLETED','DISPUTED']) with CLIENT_UNRESPONSIVE_48H and quotes [] → 409, no refund. c) RACE accept between the early check and the tx: the early check passes (CLAIMED_FULL, quotes []), tx.claimSlot.updateMany returns { count: 0 } → 409, no refund. Also assert updateMany was called with where objectContaining `{ request: { status: { notIn: REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES } }, quotes: { none: { status: 'ACCEPTED' } } }`. d) handleAdminReview in the tx: prisma.claimSlot.findUnique returns an open slot, tx.claimSlot.findUnique returns `{ status: 'OFFER_SENT', request: { status: 'ACCEPTED' }, quotes: [{ id: 'q1' }] }`, reason CUSTOM → 409, claimWithdrawal.create not called. e) adminReview approve where wd.claimSlot is OFFER_SENT but claimSlot.request.status 'ACCEPTED' (or claimSlot.quotes [{id}]) → 409 CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE, tx.claimWithdrawal.updateMany and credits.refund not called. f) adminReview REJECT on the same settled winner → resolves (ADMIN_REJECTED path), credits.refund not called. - New describe 'E-company-1 - roluri la retragere': g) ctx EMPLOYEE_MANAGED, user 'u9' (neither claimer nor assignee), slot inside grace (createdAt 5 min ago) → 403 `{ response: { code: 'FORBIDDEN' } }`, no tx. h) EMPLOYEE_MANAGED assignee (assignedToUserId 'u9'), 5 min after claim, VOLUNTARY_NO_REASON → resolves, refunded true. i) EMPLOYEE_MANAGED assignee 2h after claim → 403, no consume, no penalty. j) EMPLOYEE_TRUSTED claimer ('u1') 2h after claim → 403. k) MANAGER 2h after claim, VOLUNTARY_NO_REASON → allowed (consume + penalty, like the existing late test). l) Settled-winner check ordering: EMPLOYEE_MANAGED on a settled slot → 403 (the role check runs before the state check). === STEP 2 - backend WithdrawalsService (apps/backend/src/modules/claims/withdrawals.service.ts) === - Imports: add ForbiddenException from @nestjs/common and REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES from './claims.constants'. - Add a private static `isSettled(requestStatus: RequestStatus | undefined, acceptedQuotes: { id: string }[] | undefined): boolean` → `(requestStatus && REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES.includes(requestStatus)) || (acceptedQuotes?.length ?? 0) > 0`. Comment (RO, no diacritics): `// E-company-1: dupa accept castigatorul nu mai poate retrage (refund pe proiect castigat); iesirea post-accept = flux dedicat`. - Add a private `assertMayWithdraw(ctx, actingUserId, slot: { claimedByUserId: string; assignedToUserId: string | null; createdAt: Date })`: - if ctx.memberRole is OWNER or MANAGER, return; - `own = slot.claimedByUserId === actingUserId || slot.assignedToUserId === actingUserId`; - `withinGrace = Date.now() - slot.createdAt.getTime() < GRACE_30_MIN_MS`; - if own && withinGrace, return; - else throw `new ForbiddenException({ code: ERROR_CODES.FORBIDDEN, message: 'Only the owner or a manager can withdraw this claim' })`. - request(): - The findUnique include becomes `{ request: true, chatThread: true, quotes: { where: { status: 'ACCEPTED' }, select: { id: true } } }`. - Order after the NOT_FOUND check: (1) `this.assertMayWithdraw(ctx, actingUserId, slot)`; (2) the existing slot-status 409; (3) NEW `if (WithdrawalsService.isSettled(slot.request.status, slot.quotes)) throw WithdrawalsService.claimNotWithdrawable();`; (4) the existing pending check, then routing unchanged. - closeSlot(): the updateMany where becomes `{ id: claimSlotId, status: { in: OPEN_CLAIM_STATUSES }, request: { status: { notIn: REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES } }, quotes: { none: { status: 'ACCEPTED' } } }`. This is the atomic backstop under the FOR UPDATE for autoApproveRefund, handleVoluntary and adminReview (count 0 → the callers already throw 409 with no money movement). Extend the existing comment with one line. - handleAdminReview(): currentSlot = `tx.claimSlot.findUnique({ where: { id: claimSlotId }, select: { status: true, request: { select: { status: true } }, quotes: { where: { status: 'ACCEPTED' }, select: { id: true } } } })`. Throw claimNotWithdrawable if it is missing, not in OPEN_CLAIM_STATUSES, or `isSettled(currentSlot.request.status, currentSlot.quotes)`. - adminReview(): - include becomes `{ claimSlot: { include: { request: { select: { title: true, status: true } }, quotes: { where: { status: 'ACCEPTED' }, select: { id: true } } } } }`; - the early check becomes `if (dto.approve && (!OPEN_CLAIM_STATUSES.includes(wd.claimSlot.status) || WithdrawalsService.isSettled(wd.claimSlot.request.status, wd.claimSlot.quotes)))` → the existing 409 'Claim already closed; reject instead'; - reject stays allowed. The in-tx closeSlot filter covers the race. - Keep the ordering from IMPACT accept si claim (lockIdempotentOperation first, saveIdempotentResult last). Add no extra sequential queries inside the transactions beyond what is listed. === STEP 3 - failing tests for delivery (apps/backend/src/modules/fulfillment/fulfillment.service.spec.ts) === - Update the mocks: prisma.quote.findFirst resolves `{ claimSlotId: 'slot1', company: { name: 'Test' }, claimSlot: { status: 'OFFER_SENT' } }`; add `tx.claimSlot.count = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(1)`. The existing markDelivered test passes `{ companyId: 'c1', memberRole: 'OWNER' }`. - New tests: - it.each(['EMPLOYEE_MANAGED','EMPLOYEE_TRUSTED']) → markDelivered rejects `{ status: 403, response: { code: 'FORBIDDEN' } }`; prisma.$transaction and outbox.record not called. - MANAGER → resolves DELIVERED_BY_COMPANY. - Winner slot WITHDRAWN (early check: quote.claimSlot.status 'WITHDRAWN') → 409 DELIVERY_NOT_ALLOWED; tx.request.updateMany not called. - RACE: early check OFFER_SENT, tx.claimSlot.count 0 → 409 DELIVERY_NOT_ALLOWED; request.updateMany and outbox.record not called; tx.$queryRaw (FOR UPDATE) called. === STEP 4 - backend FulfillmentService.markDelivered (apps/backend/src/modules/fulfillment/fulfillment.service.ts) === - First line: `if (ctx.memberRole !== 'OWNER' && ctx.memberRole !== 'MANAGER') throw new ForbiddenException({ code: ERROR_CODES.FORBIDDEN, message: 'Only the owner or a manager can mark delivery' });`. - quote.findFirst include adds `claimSlot: { select: { status: true } }`. After the existing !quote check: `if (quote.claimSlot.status !== 'OFFER_SENT') throw new HttpException({ code: ERROR_CODES.DELIVERY_NOT_ALLOWED, message: 'Winning claim is no longer open' }, 409);`. - Inside $transaction, first: `await tx.$queryRaw\`SELECT id FROM requests WHERE id = ${requestId} FOR UPDATE\`;`, then `const open = await tx.claimSlot.count({ where: { id: quote.claimSlotId, status: 'OFFER_SENT' } }); if (open === 0) throw ;`, then the existing updateMany and outbox. Comment: `// E-company-1: acelasi lock ca retragerile; castigatorul trebuie sa fie inca OFFER_SENT (altfel completeDelivered nu mai consuma creditele)`. - Controller unchanged: role is enforced in the service for testability, and CompanyManagerGuard's message is billing-specific. === STEP 5 - shared DTO + context builder === - packages/shared/src/quote.schemas.ts, ClaimQuoteContextDto: add `requestStatus: (typeof REQUEST_STATUSES)[number];` (import REQUEST_STATUSES as a value import from './enums', following the existing import block) and `claimedAt: string;`. Comment: `// E-company-1: FE ascunde retragerea/livrarea dupa accept si in afara gratiei de 30 min`. - apps/backend/src/modules/quotes/quotes.service.ts getClaimContext (~line 776): add `requestStatus: req.status, claimedAt: slot.createdAt.toISOString(),`. There is no other constructor of this DTO (grep confirmed). - Run `pnpm -F shared build`. === STEP 6 - frontend === A) apps/frontend/src/app/[locale]/_components/claim-lifecycle-panel.tsx - Add `const me = useMe();` (from '@/hooks/use-auth') and `const company = useMyCompany();` (from '@/hooks/use-company'). - Compute: - `const isManager = company.data?.myRole === 'OWNER' || company.data?.myRole === 'MANAGER';` - `const accepted = ctx.quote?.status === 'ACCEPTED' || ['ACCEPTED','IN_EXECUTION','DELIVERED_BY_COMPANY','COMPLETED','DISPUTED'].includes(ctx.requestStatus);` - `const own = !!me.data && (ctx.assignment.claimedBy?.userId === me.data.id || ctx.assignment.assignedTo?.userId === me.data.id);` - `const withinGrace = Date.now() - new Date(ctx.claimedAt).getTime() < 30 * 60 * 1000;` - `const canWithdraw = !terminal && !accepted && (isManager || (own && withinGrace));` - Render: - if terminal, keep the existing claimClosed paragraph; - else if accepted, `

{t('withdrawLockedAccepted')}

`; - else if !canWithdraw, the same paragraph style with `{t('withdrawManagersOnly')}`; - else the existing form, unchanged. - Clarifications stay as they are. B) apps/frontend/src/app/[locale]/marketplace/claims/[claimSlotId]/page.tsx - In CompanyClaimPage, call `const company = useMyCompany();` next to the other hooks, before the early returns. - Line 100 becomes `{c.quote?.status === 'ACCEPTED' && c.claimStatus === 'OFFER_SENT' && (c.requestStatus === 'ACCEPTED' || c.requestStatus === 'IN_EXECUTION') && (company.data?.myRole === 'OWNER' || company.data?.myRole === 'MANAGER') && }`. - In DeliverButton, show the error under the button: `const err = deliver.error instanceof ApiError ? deliver.error.code : null;` and render `

{t.has(`apiErrors.${err}`) ? t(`apiErrors.${err}`) : t('apiErrors.INTERNAL_ERROR')}

` when err is set. Wrap the button and message in a `flex flex-col gap-2` div. Pentru situații excepționale, contactează administratorul platformei." - EN: "The client accepted your company's offer, so this claim can no longer be withdrawn. For exceptional situations, contact the platform administrator." - Lifecycle.withdrawManagersOnly - RO: "Doar proprietarul sau un manager al firmei poate retrage această preluare." - EN: "Only the owner or a manager of the company can withdraw this claim." - Lifecycle.apiErrors.FORBIDDEN - RO: "Nu ai permisiunea pentru această acțiune." - EN: "You do not have permission for this action." - Lifecycle.apiErrors.CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE (reworded) - RO: "Preluarea nu mai poate fi retrasă (este închisă sau clientul a acceptat oferta)." - EN: "This claim can no longer be withdrawn (it is closed or the client accepted the offer)." - Fulfillment.apiErrors.DELIVERY_NOT_ALLOWED - RO: "Lucrarea nu poate fi marcată ca livrată în starea actuală." - EN: "The work can't be marked as delivered in its current state." - Fulfillment.apiErrors.FORBIDDEN already exists. - Parity check: `node -e "const f=o=>Object.entries(o).flatMap(([k,v])=>typeof v==='object'?f(v).map(x=>k+'.'+x):[k]);const r=new Set(f(require('./apps/frontend/src/messages/ro.json'))),e=new Set(f(require('./apps/frontend/src/messages/en.json')));console.log([...r].filter(k=>!e.has(k)),[...e].filter(k=>!r.has(k)))"` must print two empty arrays. === STEP 7 - docs/notes === - CHANGELOG.md entry: E-company-1, with the acceptance checklist below. - Codex updates: - BE claims: withdrawals refused on REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES or an ACCEPTED quote; role rule; closeSlot relation filter. - BE fulfillment: markDelivered is OWNER/MANAGER only, takes FOR UPDATE, requires the winner slot OFFER_SENT. - FE marketplace firma: withdraw and deliver visibility rules. - Mention in 'Capcane' that a firm has no post-acceptance exit until the cancellation-flow package lands (admins handle it manually). === VERIFICATION === 1. plan.summary:
Implementation plan for E-admin-platform-3 (Sprint 1, P0). Step 1 (withdrawal block after accept, CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE, UI hide) was already delivered by E-company-1 in the working tree: WithdrawalsService.isSettled plus the atomic closeSlot filter, the spec cases (a) to (l), and the SETTLED_REQUEST_STATUSES check in claim-lifecycle-panel. This package only re-verifies it and adds CANCELLED to the settled lists. Remaining scope:
(1) One money primitive, settleClaimSlot (conditional updateMany, then refund/consume only when count===1), and one project-level function, ProjectClosureService.closeAcceptedProject. It is used by an audited admin close on /admin/requests/[id], where the admin must explicitly pick REFUND or CONSUME and write a note.
(2) request_project_cases: either party can report a stalled project after acceptance and the other side can confirm a mutual cancel or contest it. The admin closes the project or dismisses the case. Nothing auto-closes before the PO decides the credit policy.
(3) An expired-offer settlement worker plus a reconciliation branch, behind system_settings: enabled=false, days=14 placeholder, outcome=UNSET. It closes OFFER_SENT slots whose latest quote stayed EXPIRED N days, moves the quote to WITHDRAWN, recomputes the request, and notifies both sides. The quote.expired notification at expiry is the client's advance reminder. The client can ask for an extension on an EXPIRED quote.
(4) An 'Acordul vostru' card on both sides and an 'Acceptată pe' line instead of 'Ofertă expirată' on ACCEPTED quotes. A project-deadlines queue reminds the firm delivery_reminder_days_before=3 days before the deliveryDate and notifies both sides once the date has passed; the UI shows an overdue flag.
This needs one additive migration: new enum values RequestStatus.CANCELLED, ClaimSlotStatus.CANCELLED_PROJECT and CANCELLED_OFFER_EXPIRED; new table request_project_cases; columns requests.cancelled_at and quote_versions.extension_requested_at; 4 system_settings keys.
modules: backend: claims (settlement helper, offer-expiry-settlement processor, reconciliation sweep, constants)
backend: fulfillment (ProjectClosureService, ProjectCasesService, AdminRequestsController, client/company project-case controllers, project-deadlines processor)
backend: quotes (quote-validity processor emits quote.expired, requestExtension, isExpired/acceptedAt in DTO, schedule deadline jobs after accept)
backend: infra/queues (QUEUE_OFFER_EXPIRY_SETTLEMENT, QUEUE_PROJECT_DEADLINES), infra/calendar (Bucharest wall-clock helper), infra/event-bus (new DomainEvent types)
backend: notifications (emails for new events), audit (audit-snapshot allowlist, critical-audit-metadata.spec)
backend: prisma schema + migration + seed.ts settings
packages/shared: enums, error-codes, new project-case schemas/DTOs, QuoteDto.acceptedAt + extensionRequestedAt, ClaimQuoteContextDto.projectCase

frontend: offer-card, client-fulfillment, new agreement-card + project-case panels, marketplace claim workspace, requests list/detail status lists, claim-lifecycle-panel settled list, admin /admin/requests list + [id] detail, admin layout nav, notification-bell, use-socket, hooks (use-fulfillment, use-quotes, use-admin), messages ro.json/en.json
docs: 04-data-model (Actualizari), ERROR_CODES.md, CHANGELOG.md, Codex notes after the sprint (not docs/07, not docs/03 rules)
tables: requests (new enum value CANCELLED; new column cancelled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL)
claim_slots (new enum values CANCELLED_PROJECT, CANCELLED_OFFER_EXPIRED)
quotes (transitions only: EXPIRED->WITHDRAWN on auto-settle; ACCEPTED quote kept as history on project cancel)
quote_versions (new column extension_requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL)
request_project_cases (NEW)
system_settings (4 new keys: expired_offer_autoclose_enabled, expired_offer_autoclose_days, expired_offer_autoclose_credit_outcome, delivery_reminder_days_before)
credit_transactions / company_credit_wallets (REFUND or CONSUME through CreditsService only)
chat_threads (read_only=true on closed slots)
domain_event_outbox / notifications (new event types)
audit_logs (PROJECT_CLOSED, PROJECT_CASE_OPENED, PROJECT_CASE_RESPONDED, PROJECT_CASE_DISMISSED, QUOTE_EXTENSION_REQUESTED)
claim_withdrawals (read only: auto-settle skips slots with PENDING_ADMIN_REVIEW)
assumptions: Step 1 of the package (withdrawal block after acceptance + UI hide) is ALREADY implemented in the working tree by E-company-1 (withdrawals.service.ts isSettled/closeSlot relation filter, withdrawals.service.spec cases a-l, claim-lifecycle-panel SETTLED_REQUEST_STATUSES). This package does not rewrite it; it only adds CANCELLED to both settled lists and re-runs the spec.

A terminal 'project cancelled' outcome needs its own values: RequestStatus.CANCELLED and ClaimSlotStatus.CANCELLED_PROJECT / CANCELLED_OFFER_EXPIRED. They are additive (ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE), backward-compatible for blue/green, and the approved package explicitly asks for a terminal outcome. Reusing EXPIRED for requests would wrongly enable the client repost flow.
The ACCEPTED quote stays ACCEPTED after a project cancel as history. Delivery, review and accept are all gated on request status, so CANCELLED blocks them.

When a slot is auto-settled for an expired offer, its EXPIRED quote moves to WITHDRAWN via closeOpenQuotesForSlot. Otherwise extendValidity (which accepts EXPIRED) could resurrect a SENT quote on a closed slot.

After an auto-settle the request follows the EXISTING recompute behaviour: with no occupants left it returns to IN_MARKETPLACE with a new 5-working-day clock (Pasul 5 / D-v6-13 precedent), otherwise it drops to CLAIMED_*. The settled firm is NOT excluded from re-claiming; no new exclusion policy is invented.
Auto-settle skips slots that have a PENDING_ADMIN_REVIEW withdrawal, so the admin decision on that withdrawal is not pre-empted.

Either party can open a project case (client: FIRM_UNRESPONSIVE / MUTUAL_CANCEL_REQUEST / OTHER; firm: CLIENT_UNRESPONSIVE / MUTUAL_CANCEL_REQUEST / OTHER). The package names only the client report, but E-company-1 left the winning firm with no exit at all. The symmetric design costs one extra route.

No self-service cancel settles money: a confirmed mutual cancel still ends with the admin closing the project and choosing REFUND or CONSUME explicitly until the PO decides the fault-to-outcome mapping.

Outbox eventKey dedup is permanent (domain_event_outbox is never purged; INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), so reminder/overdue notifications with keys like project.delivery_reminder:<requestId>:<deliveryDate> are exactly-once without extra columns.

delivery_reminder_days_before=3 comes from the PO-approved package step ('remind firm 3 days before delivery'), stored as a system setting. The reminder fires at 09:00 Europe/Bucharest on deliveryDate-3 calendar days; the overdue notice fires at the first instant after the end of deliveryDate in Bucharest.
IN_EXECUTION stays unwritten: the optional 'Am inceput executia' action is an open PO question (docs/17 #14).
Logging in with curl as a demo account revokes that account's browser session (single-session invariant 3.13). This is expected during local verification.

decisions.question: Can the winning firm withdraw its claim after the client accepts?
decisions.chosen_default: No. 409 CLAIM_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE (already implemented by E-company-1; this package only adds CANCELLED to REQUEST_SETTLED_STATUSES).
decisions.why_safe: docs/03 4.8/4.15 give refunds only for valid cancellations; pay-to-play (winner consumes at COMPLETED, D-L1-1) and E-company-1 already enforce it.

decisions.question: When a project is cancelled after acceptance, are the winner's reserved credits refunded or consumed, per case (mutual, firm fault, client fault)?
decisions.chosen_default: No automatic rule. Only an admin can close the project (POST /admin/requests/:id/close) and must pick creditOutcome REFUND or CONSUME explicitly (no pre-selected option) plus a mandatory note. The close is audited and settled once through settleClaimSlot. The case records who reported and whether the other side confirmed, to inform the admin.
decisions.why_safe: It locks in no policy: the admin decides per case, as CUSTOM withdrawals already work (4.15). The code path is ready to map fault to outcome automatically once the PO decides.

decisions.question: Should a mutual cancellation confirmed by both sides close the project automatically, without admin?
decisions.chosen_default: No. The confirmation is stored on request_project_cases.response=CONFIRMED_CANCEL and admins are notified; the admin closes it.
decisions.why_safe: Automatic closing would require the undecided credit outcome.

decisions.question: After how many days does a slot whose offer expired without a client decision get closed, and are its credits refunded or consumed?
decisions.chosen_default: Worker and sweep are implemented but gated by system_settings: expired_offer_autoclose_enabled=false, expired_offer_autoclose_days=14 (placeholder aligned with the 14-day validity/extension step of D-v6-7, used only if enabled), expired_offer_autoclose_credit_outcome=UNSET. The processor is a no-op unless enabled=true AND outcome is REFUND or CONSUME. Local verification flips them via PUT /admin/settings and restores them afterwards.
decisions.why_safe: Nothing changes in production until the PO sets the values from Admin → Settings, with no deploy; neither a duration nor a refund policy is locked in.

decisions.question: Does the 4.12 penalty 'Ofertă expirată / SLA ratat individual = 3 puncte' apply when a quote's validity lapses (or when it is auto-settled)?
decisions.chosen_default: No penalty is applied at quote expiry or auto-settle. The existing SLA-miss penalty stays as is.
decisions.why_safe: 4.11 ties the 3 points to the SLA miss ('oferta/claim-ul expiră' = no offer in time); applying it to validity lapses would be a new rule. Leaving it untouched changes nothing.

decisions.question: How long before the offers expire should the client be reminded to decide?
decisions.chosen_default: No new lead time. The client gets a targeted quote.expired notification (bell and email) at the moment of expiry. It says the offer can no longer be accepted, offers 'Cere prelungirea', and states the auto-close date when auto-close is enabled. This comes before the settlement, which is what the package asks for.
decisions.why_safe: It uses only existing clocks (valid_until); no invented duration.

decisions.question: How many days before the delivery date should the firm be reminded?
decisions.chosen_default: 3 days, stored as system_settings delivery_reminder_days_before=3.
decisions.why_safe: The number is written verbatim in the PO-approved package steps; it is a notification only, with no money or state change, and editable from Admin.

decisions.question: Where does a CANCELLED request appear for the client, and can the client repost or delete it?
decisions.chosen_default: It appears in the DONE tab with statusValue 'Proiect anulat'. There is no repost and no delete: the deletable list and the repost flow are unchanged.
decisions.why_safe: It is read-only history; no new client capability.

decisions.question: Should the firm get an 'Am început execuția' action that sets IN_EXECUTION?
decisions.chosen_default: Not implemented; IN_EXECUTION remains a read-only accepted status as today.
decisions.why_safe: It is an open PO question (docs/17 #14) and is not needed for this package's done_when.

plan.summary: Plan for E-admin-platform-1 (Sprint 2, P0): harden the mail configuration so production cannot boot on a capture sink or without authenticated SMTP. The guard catches Mailpit/green-mail/*.internal hosts and ports 1025/8025, and requires a display-name MAIL_FROM and a SUPPORT_EMAIL. Other code work: a non-blocking SMTP verify at boot, connection timeouts plus requireTLS, a Reply-To SUPPORT_EMAIL and a support footer line on auth, blocked-account and account/billing emails, and an admin "send test email" endpoint (POST /admin/mail/test, only to the admin's own address, throttled and audited) with a button in /admin/settings. It also adds a support contact on the ACCOUNT_BLOCKED login error, /.well-known/security.txt built from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL, an env-driven 301 redirect from the legacy railway.app host in the Caddy gateway, and a production cutover runbook in docs/08. No DB migration. The live steps (domain, DNS SPF/DKIM/DMARC, provider credentials on blue and green, Stripe dashboard, deleting Mailpit) are blocked on the PO choosing the domain and the EU provider. The code is provider- and domain-agnostic and driven only by env, so nothing is hardcoded.
modules: backend modules/notifications (footer + Reply-To for account/billing events)
frontend admin settings page + use-admin hook
frontend auth login page (ACCOUNT_BLOCKED contact line)
docs/08-deployment.md, apps/backend/.env.example, apps/frontend/.env.example, CHANGELOG.md, Codex vault notes
tables: users (read only: the admin's own email/name/language_preference for the test email)
audit_logs (write via AuditInterceptor: new action MAIL_TEST_SENT, entityType 'mail')
assumptions: Production still sends through a Mailpit sink (docs/08:77, eu-region-migration-plan:18/61). With this release, production and the isolated Green preview will NOT boot until real SMTP creds, a display-name MAIL_FROM and SUPPORT_EMAIL are set on BOTH app-blue and app-green (or SMTP_ALLOW_DEV_HOST=true on a capture-only preview). This is intended: invariant 3.13 fail-fast plus the existing pattern from the 2026-08-23 audit. This task is local only: no deploy, no Railway variable changes, no DNS or Stripe dashboard changes.

The SMTP_ALLOW_DEV_HOST=true escape hatch already used by dev-infra/docker-compose.prod.yml and docs/implementation/container-smoke.compose.yml also exempts all the new mail-identity checks (port, auth, MAIL_FROM display name, SUPPORT_EMAIL). Those two compose files therefore stay unchanged and keep booting.
No new tables or columns. The audit action is a free string (Audit decorator takes a string), so MAIL_TEST_SENT needs no enum or migration.

E-admin-platform-2 (same sprint) owns the legal pages ([EMAIL CONTACT] placeholders), the footer operator identity and the CI placeholder check. This package does not touch Legal.* keys or site-footer.tsx.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL (frontend, baked at build time) and SUPPORT_EMAIL (backend, runtime) must hold the same address. docs/08 documents this. Keeping two vars avoids adding a public config endpoint.
Email subjects stay as they are (auth and blocked already name Cozy Home). Brand identity comes from the MAIL_FROM display name, as the finding proposes.

Next 15 app router serves app/.well-known/security.txt/route.ts, and the middleware matcher ('/', '/(ro|en)/:path*') does not intercept /.well-known/*. If the dot-folder does not route, fall back to a rewrite in next.config.mjs from /.well-known/security.txt to /security-txt, with the handler in app/security-txt/route.ts.

decisions.question: Which final domain and which EU email provider (Brevo, Postmark EU or Amazon SES eu-central-1)?
decisions.chosen_default: Code stays provider- and domain-agnostic: everything goes through env (SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS/SECURE, MAIL_FROM, SUPPORT_EMAIL, FRONTEND_ORIGIN, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL, gateway CANONICAL_HOST/LEGACY_HOSTS). No domain, provider hostname or address is hardcoded. docs/08 gets a cutover runbook the PO runs after choosing.
decisions.why_safe: docs/07 has no domain or provider decision (docs/audit-2026-08-19/10-infra-deploy.md:97 lists it as DECIZIE NECESARA #1). Env-only wiring locks in no policy, and every choice can be applied later without code changes.

decisions.question: Which monitored mailbox is SUPPORT_EMAIL (e.g. suport@<domain>), and who reads it?
decisions.chosen_default: New SUPPORT_EMAIL env var. Required in production unless SMTP_ALLOW_DEV_HOST=true. Must be a valid email, not on a reserved/test domain, and not a no-reply/noreply/donotreply local part. When absent (dev), no Reply-To header and no support line are rendered.
decisions.why_safe: No mailbox is invented. Production refuses to boot without one, so the 'reply to this email' promise in the blocked-account email can never point to a dead no-reply address again.

decisions.question: Which emails carry Reply-To SUPPORT_EMAIL? Replies to chat or offer notifications could send private project content to the support inbox.
decisions.chosen_default: Opt-in per call (send(..., { replyToSupport: true })). Enabled for: email verification, password reset, account blocked, admin test email, and the notification events company.approved/rejected/suspended/unsuspended, payment.confirmed, subscription.expiring, withdrawal.decided, project.case_opened, project.cancelled. Not enabled for message.created, quote.*, claim.*, delivery.*, request.expired, project.delivery_reminder, project.overdue. The support footer line ('Ai nevoie de ajutor? Scrie-ne la ...') is shown on ALL emails when SUPPORT_EMAIL is set.
decisions.why_safe: It covers every email the finding requires (auth, blocked, billing) and keeps replies to chat-like emails away from the support inbox. Extending the set later is a one-line change.

decisions.question: What goes in security.txt: a dedicated security@ contact, a Policy URL, and how long until Expires?
decisions.chosen_default: Contact: mailto:<NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL>. Expires = build time + 180 days (RFC 9116 asks for less than a year; every release rebuilds). Preferred-Languages: ro, en. Canonical: <SITE_URL>/.well-known/security.txt. No Policy line, because no disclosure-policy page exists yet (it is optional in RFC 9116). The route returns 404 when NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL is empty.
decisions.why_safe: It publishes only an address the PO already chose as support, promises no bounty or policy, and never publishes a placeholder contact.

decisions.question: Should production refuse to boot when mail is misconfigured, given that production is currently on Mailpit?
decisions.chosen_default: Yes. Extend the existing production superRefine guard: dev host (localhost, 127.x, ::1, 0.0.0.0, *.local, *.localhost, *.internal, first label mailpit/mailhog/maildev/smtp4dev/green-mail), port 1025/8025, missing SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS, MAIL_FROM without display name or on a reserved domain, and missing or invalid SUPPORT_EMAIL all abort boot unless SMTP_ALLOW_DEV_HOST=true. The SMTP verify at boot is log-only.
decisions.why_safe: Invariant 3.13 (secrets validated at boot, fail-fast) and the 2026-08-23 audit pattern already in config.schema. The finding's proposed_fix asks for exactly this, and the verify stays log-only so an SMTP blip never takes the site down.

decisions.question: Must the MAIL_FROM domain match the FRONTEND_ORIGIN domain?
decisions.chosen_default: Warn-only at boot (MailService logs a warning when the MAIL_FROM domain and the FRONTEND_ORIGIN host share no suffix). Not a boot failure.
decisions.why_safe: DMARC alignment is between the From domain and the SPF/DKIM domains, not the website. A hard coupling would block sending real email before the domain move, or during it.

decisions.question: Who can the admin test email be sent to?
decisions.chosen_default: Only the calling admin's own account email. No recipient parameter. Throttled to 3 per minute and audited as MAIL_TEST_SENT (snapshot keeps only ok).
decisions.why_safe: The endpoint cannot be used as an open relay or to spam third parties, and no PII goes into audit.

plan.summary: Implementation plan for E-admin-platform-2 (Sprint 2, P0): publish the operator's legal identity, finish the Terms and Privacy content, and version the acceptances. The design unblocks the code work before the PO sends the entity data. The operator identity is not hardcoded in ro.json/en.json. It comes from the existing admin-editable invoice-seller settings (seller_name/cui/reg_com/address; docs/03:202 and D-L0-1 already say these are admin-configurable) plus a new legal_contact_email key. A new gate flag, legal_identity_published, defaults to false. Legal texts use two ICU args, {operator} and {contactEmail}, filled by a public GET /legal/operator endpoint. When the flag is false the page shows a neutral 'being published' wording and never shows the seed demo data (RO12345678). Terms gain three sections backed by the docs: delivery and 14-day auto-completion (D-L1-1), reviews and disputes (4.18, D-L1-3), and penalties and suspension (4.12, company threshold only). Privacy names Railway, Stripe, Google Places, OSM Nominatim and the SMTP provider, and gets a new international-transfers section. The false 'geocoding on our servers' claim is corrected. users get terms_version and privacy_version columns. A shared constant, LEGAL_TERMS_VERSION/LEGAL_PRIVACY_VERSION, drives needsLegalAcceptance in /auth/me and login. A blocking dialog calls an audited POST /legal/accept (LEGAL_ACCEPTED, 409 LEGAL_VERSION_MISMATCH). A CI grep step plus a vitest spec fail on any remaining bracket placeholder. One additive migration is needed.

assumptions: The platform operator named in Terms and Privacy is the same legal entity that issues the credit and subscription invoices. Both use the system_settings seller_* keys (docs/03:202, D-L0-1). The PO confirms this in question Q1.

No real entity data exists anywhere in the repo or docs. The seed seller_* values (Marketplace Mobilier SRL, RO12345678, Str. Exemplu) are demo values and must never be shown as the operator's identity. The legal_identity_published flag (default false) enforces this.

Only the company-level penalty threshold is live: 12 active points in a rolling 180-day window lead to a 6-month SUSPENDED status. The employee 9-point block in docs/03 4.12 was dropped (settings cleanup migration 20260823200000 and the Sprint 7 decision), so Terms must not mention it.

The re-accept block lives in the UI only. The backend exposes needsLegalAcceptance and records the acceptance, but no global guard rejects API calls from users who have not re-accepted. Adding such a guard to the global chain would be risky for blue/green and for every module.
ADMIN accounts are exempt: needsLegalAcceptance is always false for role ADMIN. Operator staff are not counterparties to the Terms.

Version comparison is equality against the shared constants, not ordering. Any mismatch or NULL counts as outdated. On prod every existing user has NULL, so everyone sees the dialog exactly once after the release, whatever the constant's value.

POST /legal/accept requires the client to send the versions it showed. The backend rejects a mismatch with 409 so an old frontend bundle during a blue/green rollout cannot record acceptance of a text the user never saw.

The identity is fetched client-side (TanStack) because the frontend has no server-side backend-fetch path today and the pages are statically generated. The SSR HTML shows the pending wording and swaps after hydration. This is acceptable because crawlers run JavaScript and the legal text itself stays SSR.

Railway currently hosts the app in EU West and the data services (Postgres/Redis/MinIO) in another region, which docs/08 and the EU migration plan say is outside the EU. The exact region is not documented, so the Privacy text says servers 'may be located outside the EEA' and describes the Art. 46 safeguards generically until the PO or legal confirms.

Legal text changes need the PO's agreement (IMPACT text UI item 9). The new sections are implementation drafts built only from docs/03 and docs/07 facts. They must go through legal review before the prod deploy, and a text change after review before the first prod deploy only needs a version bump.

decisions.question: Where does the operator identity (legal name, CUI, J number, registered office) come from, given the PO has not sent it?
decisions.chosen_default: Reuse the existing admin-editable seller_* system settings (docs/03:202 'Date furnizor (seller) configurabile în Admin'; D-L0-1 'datele fiscale reale din Admin → Setari'). Add legal_contact_email ('') and a gate flag legal_identity_published ('false'). Show the identity only when the flag is 'true' and all five values are non-empty.
decisions.why_safe: No entity data is invented or committed. Terms and invoices share one source, so they cannot drift. The flag stops the seed demo values from ever being shown publicly. The PO fills the data in Admin → Settings on the active slot with no code deploy, and this step was already a pre-launch checklist item in docs/08:128.

decisions.question: Exact legal entity data: legal name, CUI, J number, registered office, contact/DPO email. Is the operator the same entity as the invoice seller?
decisions.chosen_default: Blocked on the PO. After deploy, the PO sets seller_name, seller_cui, seller_reg_com, seller_address and legal_contact_email in Admin → Settings on the active slot, checks /ro/terms, then sets legal_identity_published=true.
decisions.why_safe: Until the flag is set, pages show the neutral pending wording rather than fake data or brackets. The done_when items 'real name, CUI and address visible' and 'footer shows operator' become true when the PO completes this step.

decisions.question: Which Railway region hosts the production data services, and will the EU migration (eu-region-migration-plan, PROPUS) happen before launch?
decisions.chosen_default: Generic wording: hosting by Railway Corporation (USA). The application runs in the EU (Western Europe), and databases and file storage may be located outside the EEA. Transfers rely on the EU Commission standard contractual clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR) or, where applicable, the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision.
decisions.why_safe: The wording is true whether or not the data moves. It discloses the non-EU risk the finding flags and makes no claim about a specific region that could turn out false.

decisions.question: Which SMTP provider should the Privacy processor list name?
decisions.chosen_default: Name the provider if E-admin-platform-1's decision (Brevo / Postmark EU / Amazon SES) is recorded in docs/07 or CHANGELOG when this package is implemented. Otherwise use the category wording 'furnizorul nostru de trimitere a emailurilor tranzacționale' and flag it in CHANGELOG as a pending text edit that needs a version bump.
decisions.why_safe: Avoids naming a provider that has not been chosen.

decisions.question: Legal review of the new Terms sections (delivery and auto-completion, reviews and disputes, penalties and suspension) and of the processor and transfer text, including Stripe's contracting entity and Railway's DPA/SCC status.
decisions.chosen_default: Implement drafts built strictly from docs facts: D-L1-1, 4.18, D-L1-3, 4.12 (company scope), D-L1-2 and invariant 3.8. The PO or a lawyer reviews them before the prod deploy.
decisions.why_safe: No rule, number or policy beyond docs/03 and docs/07 is added. The package's risks note already names this review gate.

decisions.question: Terms content for delivery and 14-day auto-completion, reviews and disputes, penalties and suspension, and account blocking.
decisions.chosen_default: Follow the docs as written. D-L1-1: 14 calendar days after the firm marks delivery, auto COMPLETED, the winner's credits are consumed, a review becomes possible, both parties are notified. 4.18: a review is possible only after COMPLETED, and a review under 3 stars automatically becomes a dispute handled by the admin. D-L1-3: RESOLVED keeps the review; DISMISSED deletes it and the client may review again. 4.12: 3 points for an expired offer or a missed SLA, 3 each when all claimants miss the SLA, 2 for a voluntary withdrawal without reason after the 30-minute grace, points expire individually after 180 days, and 12 active points mean 6 months SUSPENDED, all configurable by the admin. D-L1-2: an admin may block an account, sessions are revoked, and the user gets an email.
decisions.why_safe: These are final decisions and business rules. They are only described, not changed.

decisions.question: Do admins also have to re-accept, and does privacy require 'acceptance' or only acknowledgement?
decisions.chosen_default: Admins are exempt. The dialog wording is 'I accept the Terms and acknowledge the Privacy Policy', and one click records both versions.
decisions.why_safe: GDPR requires informing users about processing, not consenting to the policy. The acknowledgement wording avoids wrongly presenting the privacy notice as consent. Exempting admins changes nothing for users.

decisions.question: Should the backend block all API usage until the user re-accepts?
decisions.chosen_default: No. The block is in the UI only, through a blocking dialog on every [locale] route except /terms and /privacy, with Logout as the way out. The backend only computes the flag and records the acceptance.
decisions.why_safe: A new global guard would touch every module and the blue/green standby behaviour. The done_when only asks for a blocking dialog that appears once and is audited.

decisions.question: How often can versions be bumped (risk of annoying users)?
decisions.chosen_default: Bump LEGAL_TERMS_VERSION / LEGAL_PRIVACY_VERSION only for material text changes that passed review. A comment on the constant states this. Identity changes made in Admin → Settings do not bump the version.
decisions.why_safe: Keeps the forced dialog rare. On prod every current user has NULL, so the first release triggers exactly one prompt per user.

PACKAGE E-admin-platform-2 (Sprint 2 P0): operator identity, full Terms and Privacy, versioned acceptance. Se schimba DOAR la o modificare materiala revizuita juridic; orice schimbare cere re-acceptare de la toti userii. export const LEGAL_TERMS_VERSION = '2026-09-29'; export const LEGAL_PRIVACY_VERSION = '2026-09-29'; export const legalAcceptSchema = z.object({ termsVersion: z.string().min(1).max(32), privacyVersion: z.string().min(1).max(32) }); export type LegalAcceptInput = z.infer<...>; export type LegalOperatorDto = { published: false } | { published: true; name: string; cui: string; regCom: string; address: string; contactEmail: string }; Export it from src/index.ts. 1b. auth.schemas.ts: add `needsLegalAcceptance: boolean` to the AuthUser interface. 1c. error-codes.ts: append LEGAL_VERSION_MISMATCH: 'LEGAL_VERSION_MISMATCH' at the END of the list, with a comment '// E-admin-platform-2 - versiune texte juridice depasita (409)'. 1d. Run `pnpm -F shared build`. === STEP 2 - schema + migration === 2a. In the schema.prisma model User, after termsAcceptedAt: // E-admin-platform-2: versiunile Termenilor/Politicii acceptate (NULL = conturi vechi → re-acceptare) termsVersion String? @map("terms_version") @db.VarChar(32) privacyVersion String? @map("privacy_version") @db.VarChar(32) 2b. Run `ls apps/backend/prisma/migrations | tail -3`. Use a unique timestamp later than 20260929120000, e.g. 20260929150000_legal_acceptance_versions. The migration.sql should contain: -- E-admin-platform-2 (2026-09-29): versiunea Termenilor/Politicii acceptata per user + 2 chei system_settings (identitatea operatorului). Strict aditiv (blue/green safe). ALTER TABLE "users" ADD COLUMN "terms_version" VARCHAR(32), ADD COLUMN "privacy_version" VARCHAR(32); INSERT INTO "system_settings" ("key", "value", "updated_at") VALUES ('legal_contact_email', '', now()), ('legal_identity_published', 'false', now()) ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING; -- Rollback: 1) redeploy imaginea anterioara pe ambele sloturi; 2) DELETE FROM "system_settings" WHERE "key" IN ('legal_contact_email','legal_identity_published'); 3) ALTER TABLE "users" DROP COLUMN "privacy_version", DROP COLUMN "terms_version"; Cross-check the SQL with `pnpm -F backend exec prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --shadow-database-url `. Only the ALTER should appear. 2c. Run `pnpm -F backend prisma migrate deploy`, then `pnpm -F backend prisma generate`. On Windows, if generate fails with EPERM (engine locked by `nest --watch`), stop the backend dev server, generate, then restart it with `pnpm -F backend dev` in the background. 2d. In seed.ts SYSTEM_SETTINGS, after seller_iban, add: // E-admin-platform-2: contact juridic/GDPR + publicarea identitatii operatorului (seller_*) in Termeni/Politica/footer. 'false' pana cand PO completeaza datele reale. legal_contact_email: '', legal_identity_published: 'false'. === STEP 3 - backend === 3a. New modules/legal/legal.constants.ts: SETTING_LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL='legal_contact_email', SETTING_LEGAL_IDENTITY_PUBLISHED='legal_identity_published', and LEGAL_OPERATOR_KEYS = ['seller_name','seller_cui','seller_reg_com','seller_address', SETTING_LEGAL_CONTACT_EMAIL, SETTING_LEGAL_IDENTITY_PUBLISHED]. 3b. legal.service.ts, LegalService(prisma): - getOperator(): Promise. ONE query: prisma.systemSetting.findMany({ where: { key: { in: LEGAL_OPERATOR_KEYS } } }). Do not call SettingsService six times, because each call costs ~150 ms cross-region. Trim the values. If published !== 'true' or any of the five values is empty, return { published: false }. Otherwise return { published: true, name, cui, regCom, address, contactEmail }. This is read-only, with no writes (standby rule). - accept(userId, dto): if dto.termsVersion !== LEGAL_TERMS_VERSION or dto.privacyVersion !== LEGAL_PRIVACY_VERSION, throw new ConflictException({ code: ERROR_CODES.LEGAL_VERSION_MISMATCH, message: 'Legal texts were updated; reload and review them' }). - mail: production boot aborts on a capture/internal SMTP host, ports 1025/8025, unauthenticated SMTP, MAIL_FROM without a display name, or a missing/no-reply SUPPORT_EMAIL (SMTP_ALLOW_DEV_HOST escape hatch kept); opt-in Reply-To support, requireTLS, timeouts, non-blocking verify, support footer

plan.summary: E-company-9 plan: publish a public "Reguli pentru firme" page (/ro/firm-rules, /en/firm-rules). It covers verification, the reapply block, trial, credits (reserve, consume, refund, i.e. pay-to-play), SLA, withdrawals, penalty points, suspension and how changes work. All numbers come live from a new public read-only endpoint GET /legal/firm-rules, built from system_settings, penalty_rules and the backend constants that enforce them. The page gets linked from the register?role=company checkbox, company onboarding and the dashboard, the wallet (buy-credits section, purchase confirm dialog, penalties card), the claim panel, the withdraw section (with a per-reason outcome hint) and the Terms page. Terms text and LEGAL_TERMS_VERSION stay unchanged, so nobody is forced to re-accept. Credit validity is left off the page because nothing enforces it. No migration. The lawyer review stays a PO gate.

assumptions: E-admin-platform-2 (Sprint 2, uncommitted, same day) already rewrote Legal.terms. Section 7 already discloses penalty points, the 180-day window and the 12-point / 6-month suspension; section 6 still defers to the unpublished 'regulile Platformei'. This package publishes those rules as a separate page. It does not rewrite the Terms text.

The page describes only behaviour the code enforces today (verified in code). Voluntary grace is 30 min (withdrawals.service GRACE_30_MIN_MS). SLA is 3/3/5 working days plus 12h grace (claims.constants). A clarification adds +1 working day and pauses the SLA (clarifications.service). An SLA miss consumes the credits and gives SLA_MISS points (sla-breach.processor). A losing firm that sent an offer has its credits consumed (OFFER_LOST); an ACTIVE slot without an offer gets a refund when another offer is accepted (D-L0-3). Deleting a request refunds. An unassigned claim is auto-cancelled with a refund after 60 min (ASSIGN_DEADLINE_MS). CLIENT_UNRESPONSIVE_48H and REQUEST_MODIFIED_POST_CLAIM are auto-refunded. CLIENT_CONTACT_INVALID, CLIENT_REQUESTED_CANCELLATION and CUSTOM go to admin review (D-L0-5): approved means a refund, rejected means the claim continues. The winner's credits are consumed at completion, or by auto-complete after 14 days (D-L1-1). An admin project cancellation uses an explicit REFUND/CONSUME choice (E-admin-platform-3). The reapply block is 3 months on CUI OR owner email (companies.constants REAPPLY_BLOCK_MONTHS). Trial settings live in system_settings. Suspension expires automatically (reconciliation.processor).

MASS_SLA_MISS is seeded and editable in Admin but never applied: each firm that misses gets SLA_MISS individually, and firms that breached are excluded from re-claiming once the request is republished. The page therefore lists only SLA_MISS and VOLUNTARY_WITHDRAWAL and describes the exclusion. The existing Terms section 7 wording stays correct in effect while both rules are 3 points.
The employee-scope 9-point block is NOT enforced (memory: sprint 7 skipped it; penalties.service says 'blocul pe angajat e descopat'), so it is not disclosed.
Expired-offer auto-close is disabled (expired_offer_autoclose_enabled=false, outcome UNSET), so it is not disclosed.

Claim cost is computed per request from the base score (sizing.service creditCostFromBaseScore), so the page states that the cost is shown on each request. It gives no numbers. That avoids locking anything E-company-21 may change.

CompanyApprovedGuard blocks a SUSPENDED firm from marketplace, claims, lifecycle, quotes, chat, fulfillment, billing and payments; only GET /penalties stays reachable. The page therefore says the firm 'cannot see or claim requests and has no access to the firm work features'. It does not promise that ongoing projects continue.
ro.json/en.json currently use LF line endings (checked with od), not CRLF as the older Codex note says. Preserve whatever the file has, and keep the 2-space indent.
Other Sprint 3 packages (E-admin-platform-4 invoicing) may edit ro.json/en.json and billing files at the same time. Make targeted key insertions, never a full rewrite.

decisions.question: Do purchased credite expire, and after how long? Can the rules page state credit validity?
decisions.chosen_default: Say nothing about credit validity on the page (no sentence either way). docs/03 4.16 says 'Creditele raman valabile 3 luni dupa expirarea abonamentului', but nothing in apps/backend enforces it, and the plan moves that decision to E-company-21 (Sprint 22). Disclosing an unenforced rule, or claiming credits never expire, would lock a policy either way.
decisions.why_safe: The page describes only enforced behaviour. Adding one section later, once E-company-21 implements expiry, is additive.

decisions.question: Should the firm rules be a versioned legal document that forces re-acceptance (bump LEGAL_TERMS_VERSION or add a separate firm-rules version)?
decisions.chosen_default: No version bump and no new acceptance column. The Legal.terms text stays unchanged. The rules page says it details sections 6-7 of the Terms and shows the current Terms version label. The company register checkbox label links the rules next to the Terms. The link from the Terms page is a UI CTA below the article, outside the legal text.
decisions.why_safe: It avoids forcing every client and firm through the re-acceptance dialog for purely informational disclosure of rules already enforced and already summarised in Terms section 7. No schema change. PO can still choose to bump the version after legal review.

decisions.question: Lawyer approval of the RO/EN text (done_when #1).
decisions.chosen_default: Ship the page ungated, like the Sprint 2 Terms, because it states only enforced rules with live values. Record 'revizuire juridica' as an open PO item in the CHANGELOG acceptance checklist (unchecked).
decisions.why_safe: Hiding the page behind a flag would recreate the current gap, where firms are bound by rules they cannot read. Every number is read live, so the text cannot drift from enforcement.

decisions.question: Which thresholds does the page show, and where do they come from?
decisions.chosen_default: docs/03 4.12 already makes company_penalty_threshold=12 and company_suspension_months=6 configurable in system_settings, and penalty_rules holds the points. Read them live, together with max_claims_per_request and the trial_* keys. The hardcoded enforcement constants (SLA days, grace periods, 180-day window, 60-min assign deadline, 48h, 3-month reapply, 14-day auto-complete) come from the same exported constants the enforcing code uses. No new setting keys and no value changes.
decisions.why_safe: The page reads the exact values the enforcing code uses and invents no numbers.

decisions.question: A suspended firm loses access to ongoing accepted projects (chat, fulfillment, quotes) because CompanyApprovedGuard blocks everything except /penalties. Is that the intended sanction?
decisions.chosen_default: Leave the behaviour untouched and describe it neutrally ('no access to firm work features during suspension'). Do not promise that ongoing projects continue.
decisions.why_safe: The page stays accurate whichever way PO decides later. No enforcement changes.

decisions.question: MASS_SLA_MISS points are editable in Admin but never applied. Should the mass-miss case add extra points?
decisions.chosen_default: Don't touch it. docs/03 4.11/4.12 says 3 points each when all firms miss, and today each firm gets 3 via SLA_MISS. The page lists only enforced rules. Flagged in the CHANGELOG as a known gap (admin edits to MASS_SLA_MISS have no effect).
decisions.why_safe: No change to penalty behaviour. The disclosure matches enforcement.

plan.summary:
Plan for E-admin-platform-4, "Make invoices legal before taking real payments". It has five parts:
(1) A billing-readiness check. Seller data must be real before anything is sold: no empty fields, no seed placeholders, a valid RO CUI checksum and a valid IBAN (mod-97). Until then, all three purchase endpoints (credits, subscription, "Continuă plata") and every confirm() source refuse with 503 BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED. The wallet stops showing the fake IBAN, and every /admin page shows a red banner.
(2) An audited "Date fiscale" admin form with CUI/IBAN validation, served by a new endpoint that saves all 5 seller_* keys in one transaction. The seed now leaves seller_* empty.
(3) Stripe test/live safety. Production refuses non-live keys unless STRIPE_ALLOW_TEST_MODE=true. Webhook events whose livemode differs from the key mode are rejected. Orders get a test_mode flag, and test orders never consume a fiscal invoice number (status NOT_REQUIRED). TEST MODE banners appear in the wallet and in admin.
(4) The buyer is frozen on the invoice: buyer_snapshot is written at confirm.
(5) e-Factura tracking that works with any route. The e-Factura route itself is DECIZIE NECESARA, so this plan uses the manual accountant route by default: per-order e_invoice_status (PENDING/UPLOADED/VALIDATED/REJECTED/NOT_REQUIRED) plus the ANAF upload/download ids, shown and editable in /admin/payments, an audited status update, a monthly CSV export and an admin PDF download.
One additive migration is needed. No prices or business numbers change.
modules: billing (payments.service, payments.controller, stripe.service, invoice-pdf.service, new billing-readiness.service + billing-ready.guard + admin-billing.controller + e-invoice-export.service, dto/)
packages/shared (new fiscal.ts validators, billing.schemas DTOs, enums E_INVOICE_STATUSES, error-codes BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED)
prisma (schema MockBillingOrder + enum EInvoiceStatus, migration, seed.ts, seed-demo.ts)
frontend admin (layout banner, settings fiscal form, payments e-Factura column/dialog/export/PDF)
frontend marketplace wallet (TEST MODE banner, billing-not-ready state, test orders)
tables: mock_billing_orders (ADD test_mode, buyer_snapshot, e_invoice_status, anaf_upload_id, anaf_download_id, e_invoice_updated_at + index; backfill e_invoice_status='PENDING' for CONFIRMED rows with invoice_number)
system_settings (seller_name/cui/reg_com/address/iban: read by readiness, written by new PUT /admin/billing/seller; seed default becomes '' - no data migration of existing rows)
new Postgres enum e_invoice_status
audit_logs (new actions SELLER_DETAILS_UPDATED, E_INVOICE_STATUS_UPDATED via AuditInterceptor)
stripe_events (unchanged; livemode-mismatch events are NOT recorded)
companies (read-only: buyer snapshot at confirm, legacy buyer fallback in PDF/export)
files: apps/backend/prisma/migrations/20260929170000_billing_readiness_e_invoice/migration.sql (NEW; verify timestamp is unique with ls first)
assumptions: The 5 seed values in prisma/seed.ts:150-154 are placeholders, including seller_name 'Marketplace Mobilier SRL' (the brand is Cozy Home, and docs/08:180 plus the audits call them fictitious). The guard compares against exactly these values: trimmed, case-insensitive, IBAN without spaces.

The seller is a Romanian legal entity. The CUI must pass the RO control-digit algorithm (key 753217532), with an optional 'RO' prefix. The IBAN must pass ISO 13616 mod-97 and, when it starts with RO, be 24 characters long. Reg. Com., address and name are only checked for non-empty and not-placeholder, because the ONRC number format changed in 2024 and a strict regex would lock in one format.

Local dev keeps Stripe disabled (apps/backend/.env has no STRIPE_* keys), so local purchases use bank transfer plus admin confirm. The local DB still holds the seed placeholders, which is the state the acceptance test needs.
Existing CONFIRMED orders (local 4, prod unknown) were never reported. The migration backfills them to e_invoice_status='PENDING' so they show up as 'De raportat' and are not silently skipped.

An old slot (blue/green rollback image) that confirms an order after the migration leaves e_invoice_status NULL. The DTO maps CONFIRMED + invoiceNumber != null + NULL status to 'PENDING', so the listing stays correct.
Admin auth in local curl uses httpOnly cookies from POST /api/v1/auth/login (cookie jar). The Idempotency-Key must be a UUID v4.
BusinessCalendarService (global CalendarModule) provides bucharestWallClock(dateOnly, hour). It is used for month boundaries in Europe/Bucharest (invariant 3.3).

decisions.question: Which e-Factura route: invoicing provider API (SmartBill/Oblio/FGO), direct ANAF SPV upload (UBL CIUS-RO + OAuth), or monthly accountant export/manual SPV upload?
decisions.chosen_default: Manual accountant route only, on provider-agnostic storage. Per-order e_invoice_status (PENDING/UPLOADED/VALIDATED/REJECTED/NOT_REQUIRED) plus anaf_upload_id/anaf_download_id. An audited admin PATCH records what the accountant did in SPV. There is a monthly CSV invoice register (GET /admin/billing/e-invoice-export?month=YYYY-MM) and an admin PDF download. No provider SDK, no UBL, no ANAF OAuth.
decisions.why_safe: The finding itself calls this the minimum step before launch. The columns and statuses fit all three routes (SmartBill/Oblio also return the ANAF upload index), so a later provider or UBL worker only has to write the same columns. D-L0-1 (invoices generated by the platform) is untouched, and no money or pricing policy changes.

decisions.question: Invoices already issued with placeholder seller data (sellerSnapshot = seed values): storno or leave as is?
decisions.chosen_default: No code change. Those orders are backfilled to e_invoice_status=PENDING and show up in the export, so the accountant can decide. The storno flow stays post-MVP (payments.service.ts:361 comment, ro-invoice skill).
decisions.why_safe: Nothing is deleted or renumbered. The fiscal sequence stays continuous.

decisions.question: When STRIPE_ALLOW_TEST_MODE=true is set on a production deployment (the rollout 'verify Checkout in test mode' window), should test payments still grant credits/subscription days?
decisions.chosen_default: Production refuses test keys at boot unless the flag is set. The flag is documented as 'isolated staging only'. When test mode is active, orders are created with test_mode=true: the benefit is granted, so staging flows work, but they NEVER get invoice_series/number and e_invoice_status is NOT_REQUIRED. Admin and wallet show a TEST MODE banner and the orders carry a 'Test' badge.
decisions.why_safe: With the default config the acceptance holds: a test card cannot buy on production. The override is explicit and visible, and no fiscal number is ever consumed by test money.

decisions.question: New error code BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED vs reusing PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE for the readiness 503
decisions.chosen_default: New code BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED (HTTP 503), added at the end of ERROR_CODES, with FE messages in the Billing and AdminPayments namespaces.
decisions.why_safe: It is a technical contract detail. The FE can show an actionable message ('platforma isi finalizeaza datele de facturare') instead of the misleading 'plata online indisponibila'.

decisions.question: Should the readiness guard also block Stripe webhook confirmations (not only purchases and admin confirm)?
decisions.chosen_default: Yes. confirm() checks readiness for every source. The webhook gets a 503, the event is not recorded in stripe_events, Stripe retries for up to 3 days, and a logger.error is written. In practice this can only happen when the seller data is broken after a checkout started, because the purchase guard blocks new checkouts.
decisions.why_safe: It never snapshots placeholder or invalid seller data onto a numbered invoice. The benefit is delayed, not lost: the retry succeeds once the data is fixed.

decisions.question: Freeze buyer data on the invoice at confirm (buyer_snapshot) instead of reading companies live at PDF time
decisions.chosen_default: Add mock_billing_orders.buyer_snapshot {name, cui, regCom, address}, written once in confirm(). The PDF and export use the snapshot and fall back to a live read via withDeletedRecords('ISSUED_INVOICE') for legacy rows.
decisions.why_safe: docs/03 4.17 requires the client on the invoice. The ro-invoice skill says: snapshot at issue, immutable afterwards, including the client data. The change is additive and nullable.

decisions.question: Month boundaries for the accountant export
decisions.chosen_default: Calendar month in Europe/Bucharest on confirmed_at, via BusinessCalendarService.bucharestWallClock(YYYY-MM-01, 0) to the start of the next month.
decisions.why_safe: docs/02 3.3: DB in UTC, business calendar in Europe/Bucharest.

decisions.question: Seed seller_* empty vs keep placeholders
decisions.chosen_default: The seed sets seller_* to '' (the package step). There is no data migration of existing rows, since an admin may already have entered real values. The guard still catches the old seed values.
decisions.why_safe: Î14 / D-L0-1: the seller is configurable from Admin without a deploy. This only changes the default for fresh databases.

plan.brief:
IMPLEMENTER BRIEF: E-admin-platform-4 (Sprint 3, P0): "Make invoices legal before taking real payments"

BEFORE CODING
Read these first:
- .claude/skills: prisma-migration, nestjs-module, ro-invoice, ui-component, security-close.
- Codex: "10 Module BE/BE billing.md", "COMMON settings.md", "50 Impact/IMPACT schema Prisma.md", "IMPACT endpoint nou.md", "IMPACT env si deploy.md", "IMPACT text UI.md", "IMPACT enum de status.md".

Hard rules:
- Do not touch apps/backend/.env.
- Do not touch docs/07.
- Do not change prices, VAT or series.
- No git commit.
- Comments in Romanian without diacritics.
- ro.json and en.json use CRLF with 2-space indentation.

=== STEP 1: shared (packages/shared) ===
1a. NEW src/fiscal.ts (export it from index.ts):
- normalizeCui(v): trim, uppercase, remove spaces and an optional leading 'RO'.
- isValidRoCui(v): the body is 2..10 digits. Pad the digits before the control digit to 9 with leading zeros. Multiply by the key 7,5,3,2,1,7,5,3,2, sum, then c = (sum*10) % 11, and c = 10 becomes 0. Compare c to the last digit.
  - Must pass: RO12345674, 40298306.
  - Must fail: RO12345678 (the seed value, control 4 ≠ 8), 'abc', ''.
- normalizeIban(v): uppercase, remove all whitespace.
- isValidIban(v):
  - Format /^[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}$/.
  - If it starts with RO, the length must be 24.
  - Mod-97: move the first 4 chars to the end, letters become numbers (A=10), iterative remainder must be 1.
  - Must pass: RO08TEST0000000000000001, and RO49AAAA1B31007593840000 (the seed; it passes mod-97, which is why the placeholder comparison is also needed).
  - Must fail: RO49AAAA1B31007593840001.
- SELLER_FIELDS = ['name','cui','regCom','address','iban'] as const.
- type SellerField.
- SELLER_PROBLEM_REASONS = ['MISSING','PLACEHOLDER','INVALID'] as const.
1b. NEW src/fiscal.test.ts (vitest): the cases above.
1c. enums.ts: E_INVOICE_STATUSES = ['PENDING','UPLOADED','VALIDATED','REJECTED','NOT_REQUIRED'] as const, plus type EInvoiceStatus. Keep parity with the Prisma enum.
1d. error-codes.ts: add BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED: 'BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED' at the END of the list, with the comment "// E-admin-platform-4 - date fiscale furnizor incomplete/placeholder (503)".
1e. billing.schemas.ts:
- PaymentInstructionsDto: add billingReady: boolean and stripeMode: 'live' | 'test' | null. bankTransfer stays null when !billingReady.
- BillingOrderDto: add testMode: boolean.
- AdminBillingOrderItemDto: add testMode: boolean, eInvoiceStatus: EInvoiceStatus | null, anafUploadId: string | null, anafDownloadId: string | null, eInvoiceUpdatedAt: string | null.
- NEW SellerDetailsDto { name, cui, regCom, address, iban } (strings).
- NEW BillingReadinessDto { ready: boolean; problems: { field: SellerField; reason: 'MISSING'|'PLACEHOLDER'|'INVALID' }[]; stripeMode: 'live'|'test'|null; eInvoicePendingCount: number }.
- NEW updateEInvoiceSchema = z.object({ status: z.enum(['PENDING','UPLOADED','VALIDATED','REJECTED']), anafUploadId: z.string().trim().regex(/^\d{1,20}$/).optional(), anafDownloadId: z.string().trim().regex(/^\d{1,20}$/).optional() }).refine(v => v.status !== 'UPLOADED' && v.status !== 'VALIDATED' || !!v.anafUploadId, 'anafUploadId required').
- Also export UpdateEInvoiceInput.
Then run: pnpm -F @marketplace/shared build && pnpm -F @marketplace/shared test.

=== STEP 2: Prisma schema + migration ===
2a. schema.prisma:
- Add enum EInvoiceStatus { PENDING UPLOADED VALIDATED REJECTED NOT_REQUIRED @@map("e_invoice_status") }.
- Add to MockBillingOrder:
  - testMode Boolean @default(false) @map("test_mode")
  - buyerSnapshot Json? @map("buyer_snapshot")
  - eInvoiceStatus EInvoiceStatus? @map("e_invoice_status")
  - anafUploadId String? @map("anaf_upload_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  - anafDownloadId String? @map("anaf_download_id") @db.VarChar(32)
  - eInvoiceUpdatedAt DateTime? @map("e_invoice_updated_at") @db.Timestamptz()
  - @@index([eInvoiceStatus])
- Comment: "// E-admin-platform-4: e-Factura (ruta manuala pana la decizia PO), cumparator inghetat, comenzi Stripe test fara numar fiscal".
2b. Migration folder: first run `ls apps/backend/prisma/migrations | tail` and pick a unique timestamp, e.g. 20260929170000_billing_readiness_e_invoice. Generate the SQL with prisma migrate diff --from-migrations prisma/migrations --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --shadow-database-url <DATABASE_URL from .env; read it, never edit it>, then check it against:

  CREATE TYPE "e_invoice_status" AS ENUM ('PENDING','UPLOADED','VALIDATED','REJECTED','NOT_REQUIRED');
  ALTER TABLE "mock_billing_orders" ADD COLUMN "test_mode" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ADD COLUMN "buyer_snapshot" JSONB, ADD COLUMN "e_invoice_status" "e_invoice_status", ADD COLUMN "anaf_upload_id" VARCHAR(32), ADD COLUMN "anaf_download_id" VARCHAR(32), ADD COLUMN "e_invoice_updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ;

2c. seed.ts: set seller_name/seller_cui/seller_reg_com/seller_address/seller_iban to '' with the comment "// E-admin-platform-4: goale - adminul completeaza datele reale in Admin -> Setari -> Date fiscale; pana atunci cumpararile/confirmarile raspund 503 BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED". Keep upsert update:{} as it is.

=== STEP 3: config + Stripe mode ===
3a. config.schema.ts:
- Add STRIPE_ALLOW_TEST_MODE: z.string().optional().default('false').transform(v => v === 'true'), with the comment "supapa explicita DOAR pentru staging izolat; pe productia reala nu se seteaza".
- In superRefine:
  (i) If STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set and does not match /^(sk|rk)_(live|test)_/, add an issue on STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: 'format necunoscut (sk_live_/sk_test_/rk_*)'.
  (ii) If NODE_ENV==='production' && STRIPE_SECRET_KEY && !/^(sk|rk)_live_/.test(key) && !STRIPE_ALLOW_TEST_MODE, add an issue: 'cheie Stripe de test in productie - foloseste sk_live_ sau STRIPE_ALLOW_TEST_MODE=true doar pe staging izolat'.
3b. config.schema.spec.ts: reuse the production base used by the SMTP tests. Cases:
- production + sk_test_x + whsec is rejected.
- production + sk_test_x + STRIPE_ALLOW_TEST_MODE='true' is accepted.
- production + sk_live_x is accepted.

3c. stripe.service.ts:
- Store mode: 'live' | 'test' | null, computed in the constructor from the secret prefix (/^(sk|rk)_live_/ gives live, otherwise test when a secret is present, null when disabled).

=== STEP 4: billing readiness (backend) ===
4a. NEW billing/billing-readiness.ts:
- SELLER_SETTING_KEYS = { name: 'seller_name', cui: 'seller_cui', regCom: 'seller_reg_com', address: 'seller_address', iban: 'seller_iban' }.
- SELLER_SEED_PLACEHOLDERS = { name: 'Marketplace Mobilier SRL', cui: 'RO12345678', regCom: 'J40/1234/2020', address: 'Str. Exemplu nr. 1, Bucuresti, Romania', iban: 'RO49AAAA1B31007593840000' }, with the comment "valorile istorice din seed.ts - nu pot ajunge pe o factura".
4b. NEW billing/billing-readiness.service.ts (@Injectable; deps: PrismaService, StripeService):
- readSeller(): ONE prisma.systemSetting.findMany({ where: { key: { in: [...5 keys] } } }). Latency: do not use SettingsService.getString 5 times.
- evaluate(seller) is pure:
  - For each field: trimmed empty gives MISSING.

- check(): Promise<{ ready, problems, seller (normalized: iban=normalizeIban, other fields trimmed) }>.
- assertReady(): Promise<SellerSnapshot>. When not ready, throw new HttpException({ code: ERROR_CODES.BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED, message: 'Billing details are not configured' }, 503). Return the normalized seller.

- Export BillingReadinessService.
4e. payments.controller.ts:
